title: Rome
tagline: The rise and fall of Rome
intro: Watch one Italian city become a Mediterranean empire, split in two, and lose the West.
rules: ^Rome|^Roman Republic|^Roman Empire|Western Roman Empire|Eastern Roman Empire
events: The First Punic War begins at Messana
Scipio defeats Hannibal; Carthage sues for peace
The city is razed; Africa becomes a province
Caesar defeats Vercingetorix; Gaul is conquered
Octavian takes the name Augustus; the Empire begins
Three legions destroyed; the Rhine becomes the frontier
Claudius begins the conquest of Britain
Much of the city burns under Nero
Eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD
Trajan takes Dacia and its gold
The Empire reaches its largest size as Trajan dies
A wall marks Rome's northern limit in Britain
Severus Alexander is murdered; decades of civil war follow
Emperor Valerian is captured by Shapur I
The Empire is ruled by four emperors
A new capital on the Bosporus
Emperor Valens is killed by the Goths
On his death the Empire splits into East and West for good
Attila is turned back in Gaul
Romulus Augustulus is deposed at Ravenna
Fall of the Western Roman Empire
